source: Joint Ops: Nemesis Operatives mission pack, played without a NEMESIS operative (cards 11-13 have no effect by the book; the automa lets you reassign them).

missions.name: 01 Erosion of Power
missions.placement: Ready, Conceal order, base touching the NPO killzone edge.

table.note: NEMESIS activation. No NEMESIS in play: skip.

notes: SABOTAGE NEXUS (1AP): a controlled objective is sabotaged until end of TP. Third Sabotage Nexus in a TP gives 1 Sabotage point.
Spend 1 Sabotage point to discard a drawn activation card unresolved and skip that NPO activation.
Battle ends after TP4. 1 VP per Sabotage Nexus. 7-9 major win, 5-6 minor win, 3-4 minor loss, 0-2 major loss.

missions.name: 02 Outmanoeuvre
missions.placement: Ready, Conceal order, base touching the NPO killzone edge.

table.note: Players control an objective: remove 1 point from the pool. Otherwise add 1 (do not set up yet). Then activate one NPO.
NEMESIS activation. No NEMESIS in play: skip.

notes: Half the player operatives set up outflanking. TP2 gambit: choose a neutral edge as the outflank edge, remove the nearest objective in player territory.
Players may end the battle at the end of any TP after the third. Control two objectives and contest the third: win. Control two only: minor loss. One or fewer: major loss.

missions.name: 03 Ambush
missions.placement: Ready, Conceal order, base touching the NPO killzone edge. Ambush Advantage: NPOs set up this TP have Accurate 1.

table.note: NEMESIS activation. No NEMESIS in play: skip.

notes: COORDINATE EXTRACTION (1AP): randomly determine one non-player killzone edge as the escape edge. Once per battle, not in TP1.
Battle ends when every player operative is incapacitated or escaped. 3/4 escaped: major win. 1/2: minor win. Less: major loss.

missions.name: 04 Strongpoint Assault
missions.placement: NPOs on Offence: ready, Conceal, wholly within the Offence drop zone. NPOs on Defence: ready, Conceal, within the Base area with the Defence killzone edge in control range.

table.note: NEMESIS activation. No NEMESIS in play: skip.

notes: Two objective markers start at location 1. End of each TP: Offence controls a marker, move it forward; Defence controls it, move it back.
Battle ends after TP5. A marker at location 3: Offence major win. None at 3 but both at 2: Defence minor win. Otherwise Defence major win.

custom.name: Custom
custom.placement: Ready, Conceal order, base touching the NPO killzone edge.
